map.title: Velmarche
map.attribution: Map drawn and engraved by CM Creative Lab

aubrelieu.description: Capital of the Republic, a bridge town on the Orvelle founded in 1214: the Palais des Chartes (National Archives), the Civil Re-registration Office, the opera house, the citadel, the university, the Tanneurs quarter.

bains-de-merande.description: Spa town in the coastal hills of the south-west: baths, sanatorium, the Mérande Soapworks, a girls' high school.

brenzac.description: Thalbère frontier town, bilingual, beyond the Col de Corvenne (Brénica in Thalbère).

col-de-corvenne.description: Pass through the Monts Corvins into Thalberie: blockhouses from the War of the Passes, a cross for the dead.

dalvezac.description: Thalbère hamlet of charcoal burners in the Dalva valley, away from the pass road (Dalvica in Thalbère): wooden houses, charcoal stacks, school, cemetery.

foret-de-sorbe.description: Beech wood between Aubrelieu and Moulinvert; an old paper mill is falling into ruin by the water.

golfe-d-ambre.description: The western gulf, with milder waters; amber is gathered on its beaches.

grisenoue.description: Marsh town north of Aubrelieu: reed beds and the charred ruins of the Wards' home.

hautcorvin.description: Mountain town in the upper Orvelle valley: glassworks, garrison, a paper mill that trains apprentices.

kessaar.description: A rock in the Mer Grise, off the coast of Ostrie: former penal colony (1938–1952), infirmary, small lighthouse.

lac-d-aulne.description: Lake in the foothills south of Moulinvert: summer chalets, rowing boats and alders.

landes-d-ostrie.description: Heather plateau of the north: standing stones, sheepfolds, stone tracks. Beyond lies Ostrie, its language and its fjords.

mer-grise.description: Cold northern sea, mists and seals.

monts-corvins.description: South-eastern range where the Orvelle rises: snow-capped peaks, pine forests.

moulinvert.description: Industrial town on the Clairette, at the foot of the hills: the wheels, chimneys and pulp vats of the Varenque Paper Mills, the girls' school, the cemetery.

orvelle.description: The river of Velmarche, from the Monts Corvins to the Golfe d'Ambre, and the Clairette, its left-bank tributary, coming down from the Sorbe hills: ferries, bridges, mills.

pas-de-l-ourse.description: A gap in the ridge of the Monts Corvins, south of the Col de Corvenne, on the border: carved boundary stone, iron cross at the hairpin bend; a mountain refuge a little below, on the Velmarche side.

port-senane.description: Great port on the Orvelle estuary, on the Golfe d'Ambre: docks, shipyards, the Orvelle Packet Company, the seamen's hospital, a theatre.

saint-ormel.description: Cathedral city on the Orvelle, downstream from Aubrelieu: cathedral, notaries' offices, court registry.

tennok.description: North-western tip of Ostrie: white lighthouse with a red band, the keeper's house, the lifeboat house, the post office; offshore, the reef of the Dents de Tennok.

vellaak.description: Fishing village at the head of a fjord: harbour, fish-drying racks, the offices of Vel Taalik, the Ilvess photographic studio.

vernezac.description: Village in the upper valley, on the Vèze, a torrent running down from the ridges to the Orvelle: furnace hall of the Hautcorvin Glassworks, inn, church, school, post office, customs post, guides' company.
